name: Skeleton
description:
First-load placeholder. Size it to the content it stands in for.
Decorative by default (aria-hidden).

Fully rounded by default — a line of text reads as a pill. For a block
(an image, a chart, a card) pass a block radius, e.g.
`rounded-[var(--size-border-radius-border-radius-lg)]`.

A soft highlight sweeps across it (Kinetics' Skeleton Sweep, MIT):
`theya-skeleton-sweep` in motion.css. With reduced motion it stays still.
whenToUse: First load of content whose shape is known: a card, a list, a profile header.
Short waits, roughly under a few seconds.

whenNotToUse.text: A task with known percent done
Reloading data that is already shown
whenNotToUse.instead: keep the old data and show a subtle busy state

anatomy.description: a pulsing shape; size it with `className` to the content it stands in for.

do.caption: Same layout as the real item — nothing jumps when it loads.

dont.caption: One big block: the layout shifts when content arrives.

a11y: Skeletons are hidden from screen readers; mark the loading region aria-busy="true" and remove it when done.
Fully rounded by default; give blocks (images, cards) a block radius. The sweep stops with reduced motion.
Don’t put focusable elements inside a loading region.
